_comment: Template only — no experiment has been run with this config. Copy to experiment_config.<experiment_id>.json and fill in real values at execution time (Phase 5). Every field here must be populated from a REAL run; never hand-typed as a placeholder for a results table.
research_question: one of RQ1 | RQ2 | RQ3 | RQ4
dataset_version: DATA REQUIRED (git commit hash or manifest.csv version tag at time of run)

model.model_name_used: DATA REQUIRED -- record the ACTUAL model that responded, from generation_metadata['model_name_used'], not a name chosen in advance
model.temperature: not controllable by current code -- see research/configs/model_configuration.md

baseline_condition: DATA REQUIRED (e.g. 'naive_equal_interval' | 'direct_llm_artifacts' | 'unconstrained_llm' | null for no baseline)
random_seed: N/A unless a specific script uses one (e.g. bootstrap CI resampling) -- record it explicitly if so
evaluation_version: DATA REQUIRED (git commit hash of research/evaluation/ at time of scoring)
execution_timestamp_utc: DATA REQUIRED (ISO 8601, set at actual run time)
